title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Combine pasta with bacon and remove from heat.
Mix in egg mixture quickly and season with pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken cooked in a creamy tomato-based sauce.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices.
Prepare sauce with tomato puree and spices.
Add chicken to sauce and simmer.
Finish with cream and serve hot.
